strings.zh: 几秒钟就知道结果。“我的号码”里有一个和“中奖号码”相同，就赢下面写的金额。这是一张按真实返奖比例设计的示例票，10 元一张。
strings.en: The result takes seconds. Match one of “your numbers” to a “winning number” and you win the amount printed under it. This is an example 10-yuan ticket built to the real payout ratio.
strings.note: 【审定】本页在英文版也用人民币（页面用的是中国真实价格），见 TRANSLATION.md 第 5 条。
与 Lottery.json 同款标签。中文“公益”在此是“公益性质”，英文用 public good；公益金本身按术语表作 public welfare fund。

strings.zh: 这张桌子和赌场不一样
strings.en: This table is different from a casino.
strings.note: 直译“和赌场不一样”，英文压缩；与 Lottery.json 同款句子保持一致。

strings.zh: 刮刮乐是即开型彩票，由福利彩票和体育彩票机构发行，每 10 元里有 2 元是公益金。
strings.en: Scratch-off tickets are instant lottery tickets issued by China Welfare Lottery and China Sports Lottery, and 2 yuan of every 10 yuan goes to the public welfare fund.
strings.note: 【审定】本页在英文版也用人民币（页面用的是中国真实价格），见 TRANSLATION.md 第 5 条。发行机构用两家的正式英文名。

strings.zh: 彩票是中国内地唯一合法的博彩形式，由国家的福利彩票和体育彩票机构统一发行。按《彩票管理条例》，公益金专项用于社会福利、体育等公益事业，不用于平衡财政一般预算。
strings.en: The lottery is the only legal form of gambling in mainland China, issued by the state welfare lottery and sports lottery bodies. Under the Regulations on Lottery Administration, the public welfare fund is earmarked for social welfare, sports and other public causes; it is not used to balance the general government budget.
strings.note: 与 Lottery.json 同一段，全站统一译法。法规名意译 The Lottery Administration Regulations（中文原名《彩票管理条例》），“福利彩票和体育彩票机构” → the state welfare lottery and sports lottery agencies；“不用于平衡财政一般预算” → never to balance the general budget。
规范第 2 条第 5 款：中国真实数据保持人民币。1,621 亿元 = 162.1 billion yuan（亿 = hundred million）；等价写法 162.10 billion yuan，数字 1,621 未改。

strings.zh: 2025 年全国彩票筹集的公益金，约占当年 6,280 亿元销售额的 26%。
strings.en: The public welfare fund raised by the national lottery in 2025: about 26% of that year's 628 billion yuan in sales.
strings.note: 6,280 亿元 = 628 billion yuan，数字 6,280 / 26 不变；术语表：公益金 → public welfare fund。

strings.zh: 一半给地方：养老、医疗救助、残疾人补贴等
strings.en: Half to local governments: pensions, medical aid, disability benefits and more
strings.note: 中文顿号 → 英文逗号；Half to local governments 对应“一半给地方”。

strings.zh: 约 30%：补充全国社会保障基金
strings.en: About 30%: tops up the National Social Security Fund
strings.note: 补充全国社会保障基金 → tops up the national social security fund；数字 30 不变。
中央专项公益项目 → central public-interest projects；数字 15 不变。

strings.en: About 5%: civil affairs and sports departments
strings.note: 民政与体育部门 → civil affairs and sport departments；数字 5 不变。
术语表：理性购彩 → play responsibly。

strings.zh: 法律禁止向未成年人销售彩票，也禁止赊账、记账购买。
strings.en: The law bans selling lottery tickets to minors, and bans buying on credit or on account.
strings.note: 术语表：未成年人 → minors；“赊账、记账购买” → buying on credit or on a tab（中文顿号 → 英文逗号）。

strings.zh: 把它当作对公益的小额支持，而不是投资，更不是翻身的机会。
strings.en: Treat it as a small contribution to public welfare, not an investment, and not a chance to turn things around.
strings.note: “翻身的机会” → a way to turn your life around；破折号按英文习惯用 —。

strings.zh: 本页讲的是数学，不是反对彩票：买之前知道它的期望值是多少。
strings.en: This page is about the math, not an argument against the lottery: know its expected value before you buy.
strings.note: 与 Lottery.json 同一句保持一致；术语表：期望值 → expected value。

strings.zh: 来源：《彩票管理条例》第十八条、第三十三条；2025 年彩票公益金筹集分配情况（财政部，第一财经整理，2026-09）。中央与地方各分 50%，中央部分约 60% 入社保基金、30% 为中央专项公益金、民政与体育各约 5%。
strings.en: Sources: Articles 18 and 33 of the Regulations on Lottery Administration; 2025 lottery public welfare fund collection and distribution (Ministry of Finance; compiled by Yicai, 2026-09). Central and local governments each take 50%; of the central share, about 60% goes to the social security fund, 30% to central public welfare programs, and about 5% each to civil affairs and sports.
strings.note: 来源页脚。法规名《彩票管理条例》意译为 the Lottery Administration Regulations，中文原名已保留在本 note；《第一财经》→ Yicai；“社保基金” → the social security fund。数字 18、33、2025、2026-09、50、60、30、5 全部保留。

strings.zh: “中了 10 元”的那一刻感觉像赢，其实什么都没变。你多半会用这 10 元再买一张。这和老虎机“响铃但在输”是同一个机关。

strings.en: House edge 35%: the house keeps 3.5 yuan of every 10 yuan you scratch. That is nearly 7 times the roulette house edge, and a little lower than the Double Color Ball lottery.

strings.zh: 即开型彩票资金构成：返奖 65%、公益金 20%、发行经费 15%（澎湃新闻，2024）。本页票面和奖级表为本项目设计，按 65% 返奖率精确配平。
strings.en: Where an instant lottery ticket's money goes: 65% payouts, 20% public welfare fund, 15% operating costs (The Paper, 2024). The ticket and prize table on this page are designed for this project, balanced exactly to a 65% payout rate.
strings.note: 《澎湃新闻》→ The Paper（SIXTH TONE 的母刊）；术语表：即开型彩票 → instant lottery、公益金 → public welfare fund、发行费 → operating costs、返奖率 → payout rate。数字 65、20、15、2024、65 全部保留。
